baseline: Legacy replay integration after correcting native deallocation; budget-only additionally caps classification attempts.
units: Nanoseconds per decoded synthetic flow lifecycle; decoding excluded. B/op and allocs/op are Go allocations.
caveats: These are DPI microbenchmarks, not whole-capture netcap speedups.
One-packet nDPI throughput was statistically unchanged; existing Go heuristics remain unchanged.
Eight private nDPI contexts increase fixed RSS; dpi-workers=1 is the memory-focused setting.
Small unidentified first IP packets (<=512 bytes) are replayed once on promotion to persistent native state.
Consecutive repeated enrichment calls share inspection progress; result maps remain caller-owned.
Capture extensions cannot select the parser: wireguard.pcap contains PCAPNG. sip.pcap was excluded for caplen 92 > original length 76.
Legacy LPI UNKNOWN/NO_PAYLOAD/generic UDP caching hides later detections. Corpus checks preserve legacy application detections and pin expected recovered detections.
